headline: The food inspector becoming an Indian viral sensation
standfirst: A government official is gaining massive attention for his strict restaurant hygiene

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Food safety officer Tukaram Mundhe is going viral for his aggressive restaurant inspections.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: He began conducting surprise checks to uncover hygiene lapses at various local eateries.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: His public approach to enforcing food safety standards has struck a chord with Indian diners.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Whether his high profile inspections lead to lasting changes in restaurant hygiene protocols.

caption:
Tukaram Mundhe is the food safety officer going viral in India for his restaurant inspections.

Mundhe has gained a massive following online by documenting his surprise raids on restaurants. He is actively hunting for hygiene violations to ensure diners are eating safely. It is a rare glimpse into the usually quiet world of food regulation.
